requests.text:
The world is changing, and you along with it.

Nearly a year ago, you set off on your own, leaving your former life behind to seek your fortunes on the wild frontier — a year of traveling and exploring, living on the edge of the fallen empires of yesteryear. You've earned yourself a little coin in your adventures, enough to book passage to the northernmost reaches of the known world: the Frost Marches.

You had just made it to the village of Hawkethorne, a little hamlet nestled between two ranges of craggy mountains and the endless boreal forests of the north, when the weather turned foul. What started as an autumn downpour has turned into an unseasonable blizzard, several months earlier than you'd expected first snow. The storm has only gotten more and more ferocious in the last few days, building up to a furious howl that's made continuing your journey untenable. Lucky for you, the only inn in town — a little place called the Frost Hound — had several spare rooms, though renting one for the storm's duration took the last of your spare coin.

A towering old wolf-man named Garth runs the place along with his daughter Gwyneth, the serving girl. She's pregnant, mere days from being due she says, and is the most cheerful person you've seen so far in the wintery town. Her father is gruff and reserved, but the two of them are your only company most days. At night, a few of the local shopkeepers and traders will come in for a drink or a game of cards, but the storm makes even small ventures down the dirt-packed road a less than appealing proposition.

It's been a quiet, lonely couple of days that lend themselves to contemplation about the year you've spent on the road, the life you've left behind, and who you've become...

requests.text:
Humans are the most populous race of Savarra, once heirs to the great empires of the south, though they hold little sway here in the Frost Marches. Their time came and now has faded, leaving sparse few in these parts.

The beast-kin races — the wolf-like lupines especially — are far more prominent here, living in semi-nomadic tribes and small villages like Hawkethorne. The northern reaches have been home to their kin long before the first human set foot in these lands.

Daring catfolk merchants and adventurers come to the Frost Marches in search of riches and new horizons, far removed from their desert home. Brave and cunning, these wayfarers are few in number but have eagerly carved out a place for themselves amidst the deep forests and rolling hills of the northlands. VRCTXSEP1X .

Wyld elves, touched by ancient primal powers, once stood alongside humans as equal heirs to the great Belharan Empire of old. Today, many still live in the Imperial cities that remain, but more and more have returned to the wilds, finding wisdom in the old ways. Even now, some hardy explorers venture north in hopes of making contact with their long-isolated cousins in the heart of the snow-blown forests.

Heartlander orcs are a settled, agrarian people, distantly removed from the wild and untamed barbarians heard of in legends of the Marches. They are a tall and tough people, hard working and passionate, but with warbands of islander orcs now blighting the coasts of the nearby Kingdom of Khor'minos, taking slaves and pillaging villages, only the bravest come north where they might face their distant kin. VRCTXSEP2X Your birth race tells you something about the kin and culture you descend from. It increases your starting Attributes, and may be referenced during some events that rely on your upbringing, but the Frost Marches are lands of wild magic and endless possibility. Your race is not set in stone once chosen.

What race do you descend from? Hover over each option to read additional details about it. VRCTXSEP3X There are countless races of people in the world of Savarra, but five are perhaps most common in the shattered lands of the former Belharan Empire, the realm from which you hail.

requests.text:
It's a rare breed that set aside the simple life of hearth and home and choose to become adventurers. To succeed, you've had to learn to fight, to protect yourself and those who fight alongside you. The training you've had, and the direction of your growth, is determined by your class.

If you wish to be a hard-bitten defender or a wielder of heavy weapons, choose the VRCTXSEP1X class. If you wish to dodge deftly through battle, delivering debilitating strikes, choose the VRCTXSEP2X class. To wield powerful elemental magic and summon creatures to fight at your side, choose the VRCTXSEP3X ; if your magic is more about protecting your comrades and smiting evil with a holy weapon, choose the VRCTXSEP4X . The VRCTXSEP5X weaves together unique spell-songs and hexes with dance and sexual suggestion to bolster allies and exploit enemies' desires.

Your class determines what you're able to do in combat through a combination of passive perks and active powers, which include things like magic spells and fighting styles.

Every class grants you new perks and powers as you gain experience, but with time and practice you can master a huge array of powers from your own class and others. Your choice of class will not restrict what weapons and gear you use, or even what powers you learn, though certain classes will gain greater or lesser benefits from each due to their perks.

Through training, it is possible to change your class during your adventures.
